events.summary: Read gh issue view 26 --comments for maintainer decision D5: apk packages are recorded in /licenses/os-packages-manifest.txt, not pinned, because Alpine stable removes superseded versions quickly. What was missing: no comparison between builds to detect package or version drift.
events.provenance: gh issue view 26 --comments (dasomel, repo owner, decision record D5)

events.summary: Scoped strictly to scripts/ci/apk-closure-drift.py, scripts/ci/test_apk_closure_drift.py, hack/os-packages-baseline.txt, appending extraction, drift reporting, and artifact upload steps to image-build in .github/workflows/ci.yaml, updating CONTRIBUTING.md, and this trace.
